title: Waiver of rights.
bodyText: The failure of an aggrieved person to comply with this chapter relating to the real estate recovery fund shall constitute a waiver of any rights hereunder.
bodyHtml: §467-23  Waiver of rights.  The failure of an aggrieved person to comply with this chapter relating to the real estate recovery fund shall constitute a waiver of any rights hereunder. [L 1967, c 187, pt of §1; HRS §467-23]
